dedupe_keys.name: geoclimate local climate zone comparison in 22 french communes

description: This GeoClimate application compares Local Climate Zone classifications across 22 French communes using OpenStreetMap and BD TOPO 2.2. The study authors publish its replication materials through Zenodo to make the geographic processing and comparisons reusable. Each city and source combination has GeoJSON files containing spatial-unit geometry, assigned climate-zone classes and morphology indicators. CSV class definitions, an R plotting script and a Python statistics script accompany the outputs. A separate public README explains how to recalculate classifications with GeoClimate 0.0.1 and compare them with lczexplore. The archive was published in 2023 and supports the 2024 GMD paper; it is a static study collection. It is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0, with separate licences applying to the required software. The study helps check urban inputs for heat and climate-adaptation simulations. A limitation is that differences between source databases, including incomplete building heights, affect classification. Existing data-openstreetmap records one of the input sources. No archive was downloaded or computation reproduced here.
